posts.title: Apple Should Make AppleScript Available on iOS for AI
posts.description: I carried an 11" iPad Pro with me everywhere since 2021. It’s a great size and with the keyboard it’s everything I need when I’m not programming. When Claude came out I started experimenting with it and discovered that I was hamstrung by what iOS doesn’t have that macOS does: AppleScript.

posts.title: You Are Not Ruthless Enough
posts.description: In the course of my work I see a lot of code. Sample projects, full applications, frameworks, and proofs-of-concept have all crossed my desk at one time or another. In the labs at WWDC I see various bits of code which are giving developers trouble. The source of the project doesn’t seem to matter much; the problem is the same.
